review_brief:
# Review summary

Both assigned targets now have full native, source-bound parametric families.
Neither catalog approval nor canonical authority was changed.

## `7d09ccad28c8`

Added `route_mode={straight,clockwise_elbow}`. The default is the exact canonical
keyed-ray program. The alternative turns clockwise from the computed first-ray
endpoint, so the second operation consumes an input-dependent intermediate.
Repaired the task test's copied-runtime root discovery. Final focused suite:
22/22. Bounded audit: 480 episodes and 120 full-bank pairs. Authoring preflight:
4 jobs and 32 protected-Racket evaluations. The protected causal ablation turns
at the emitter and changes the result.

## `ee5295e1813b`

Added `composition={fill_centers,connect_equal_centers}`. The default is the
exact canonical diamond-center program. The alternative connects aligned
same-color centers derived by the first step. Final focused suite: 51/51.
Bounded audit: 480 episodes and 120 full-bank pairs. Authoring preflight: all
three original labels, two ordinary staged draws, 4 jobs, and 32 protected-Racket
evaluations. The final counterfactual preserves step A and shifts only step B's
anchors; its 30×30 protected-Racket witness changes the result.

The current shared preflight mishandles canonical rows whose single `test` pair
is stored as a mapping. A task-local compatibility launcher performs only that
container normalization and retains the raw record hash; see feedback F1.

Each target also has a verified 16-view sequential public projection and a
first-turn report covering four first turns, 24 private-field invariance checks,
and four positive controls. These are reviewer-ready prototypes, not owner
acceptance or training admission. Final review was an author self-review because
no separate reviewer agent was available.
